title: `os migrate apply` and `os migrate plan` still name `--allow-destructive` as the remedy for drops that `apply` itself refuses (the pre-prompt listing and skip lines before the ownership ceremony, and `sys_comment.reactions` in the plan)
body:
**Filing gate ①: misleading operator copy at public doors, measured, with named locations.** `finding` class a. A family closure card: two locations, one shape, with an enumeration pin owed. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat (`packages/cli`), in one PR. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (`os-justin`, `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`, seat post #22648), from #24925's dev report `6298327441` (PR #24954, out-of-scope findings 2 and 3). ⛔ Not a claim.

## The shape

A door offers `--allow-destructive` as the way on for a drop that `os migrate apply` then refuses whatever flag is passed. PR #24954 (#24925) closes it for `os migrate plan`'s `organization_id` drops. These two places keep it.

## Measured (this tree at `003e41ab5`, a copy of a `create-objectstack@17.7.0` SQLite database)

1. **`os migrate apply --yes`, no flag, before the ownership ceremony.** It exits 0 and prints `⚠ 22 destructive change(s) will be SKIPPED (re-run with --allow-destructive to include them).` before applying, and `⚠ Skipped 22 destructive change(s) (re-run with --allow-destructive to include them).` after. Its pre-prompt listing (`renderPlan` with apply limits only) also prints the differ's `--allow-destructive` remedy on each `organization_id` drop. That re-run is refused whole by `apply`'s own drop gate (measured: exit 1). Location: `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts`, the pre-prompt listing and skip lines (about `:341`–`:366`, and the post-apply skip line), against the drop gate (about `:555`–`:605`).
2. **`os migrate plan`, `sys_comment.reactions`.** It lists `sys_comment.reactions: column exists in the database but not in metadata (orphaned) — "os migrate apply --allow-destructive" to drop it.`. Then `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes` exits 1 with `✗ Refusing to drop sys_comment.reactions … Run "os migrate comment-reactions" to preview …`. The plan never names `os migrate comment-reactions`. Location: `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/plan.ts`, against `apply.ts`'s inline reactions gate (about `:502`–`:553`). That gate has no exported predicate, so the plan cannot ask it today.

## Wanted

- Each door names the command that actually moves the database on (the ceremony, or `os migrate comment-reactions`) for a drop `apply` refuses. Which drops are held is read from the gate's own predicate, one source per gate. The reactions gate's predicate moves out of `apply.ts`'s inline block so the plan can ask it.
- An enumeration pin lists every `apply` drop gate (`sys_account.issuer`, `sys_comment.reactions`, `organization_id`). It asserts that `plan` and `apply`'s pre-prompt listing name that gate's remedy for each one, so a new gate cannot reopen the shape.
- `--json` documents are unchanged. A database with no held drop prints as today.

## Neighbours

- #24925 (parent, landing as PR #24954).
- #24949 (`apply.ts`: a non-interactive `--allow-destructive` run without `--yes` exits 0). Same file, so serial or folded.
- The boot's `[schema-drift]` lines are the drivers lane's: filed beside this card.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open and closed: "migrate apply skipped destructive re-run with allow-destructive refused ceremony comment-reactions plan remedy", 25 hits. None names these two locations. The nearest are #24925 (the plan's `organization_id` footer), #23925 (closed: the same shape on a Turso remote primary) and #24949 (the exit code).

Dedupe words: apply skipped re-run allow-destructive ownership ceremony; plan comment-reactions allow-destructive; remedy apply refuses.
